## Teaching & Academics
- [ISMG 2050 Course Landing](https://www.bitsmasher.net/teaching/ISMG-2050/): Undergraduate Business Problem Solving Tools.
- [ISMG 2050 Syllabus (PDF)](https://www.bitsmasher.net/teaching/ISMG-2050/syllabus/syllabus_fall_2026.pdf): Full course policies, grading, and schedule.

- [Teaching Index (JSON)](https://www.bitsmasher.net/teaching/index.json): Structured JSON catalogue of all active/past courses.
